content: Regular conversations with family members, listening to music, social interaction, and light physical activities may help reduce loneliness.
Deep breathing exercises, meditation, calming music, and maintaining healthy sleep routines may help reduce stress.
Maintaining a fixed bedtime, reducing caffeine intake, and avoiding screens before sleeping may improve sleep quality.
Walking, stretching, chair yoga, and light exercises are beneficial for elderly physical wellbeing.
Balanced nutrition including fruits, vegetables, proteins, hydration, and reduced sugar intake is important for elderly health.
Medicines should always be taken according to doctor recommendations and at proper scheduled times.
Regular blood sugar monitoring, healthy diet, hydration, and timely medicines are important for diabetes management.
Low salt intake, regular medication, stress management, and moderate exercise may help control blood pressure.
Talking with trusted people, breathing exercises, and emotional support may help reduce anxiety.
Emotional wellbeing improves with social connection, hobbies, music, and supportive conversations.
